title: Braided derived restriction with its normalized model and unit squares
statement: Let j:Y→X be an open immersion of schemes, R a commutative ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site of X, and h a braided structure on ordinary module restriction. Let b be a natural isomorphism from restriction of the total tensor to total tensor of restrictions. Assume that on every (p,q)-summand b equals the inverse ordinary tensorator of h followed by the restricted summand inclusion. Assume restriction preserves K-flat complexes and all coproducts indexed in the coefficient universe. Then the specified exact derived restriction admits a braided structure d for the prescribed native symmetric monoidal structures such that ModelNormalization(j,R,b,braidedComparison(d)) holds and braidedUnit(d)=unitComparison(h), in the normalization interface [def-pur-clopen-monoidal-normalization]. The assertion does not include uniqueness of comparisons, local pure-tensor normalization, or equivalence of a finite partition. The ordinary restriction, total comparison and summand inclusions are those of [lem-pur-clopen-total-tensor-kflat-detection], and K-flatness is [def-pc-kflat-complex].

proof.text: Apply clopen_braided_cochain_normalization to h, b, hsum and hcolim. This proved construction supplies a braided cochain structure c, identifies its inverse tensorator with b by coproduct extensionality, and gives its inverse unit as the single-complex comparison followed by the single of the ordinary inverse unit. Keep c abstract when applying derived localization.

Apply clopen_braided_localization to the concrete canonical cochain braided lift and hk. This proved specialization supplies a braided structure d on the specified derived restriction and proves that the canonical factors.hom is monoidal for the fixed native localization data. It contains the categorical K-flat criterion, K-flat resolution models and application of normalizedBraidedLocalization.

For the monoidal factorization given by normalizedBraidedLocalization, expand NatTrans.IsMonoidal.tensor. Cancel the strong tensorator of the derived restriction, the source localization tensorator and the target localization tensorator at the K-flat pair, using the inverse cochain tensorator. Their inverses are definitionally the native tensorIso maps. Replace the cochain oplax tensorator by b.hom using the summand computation; this is ModelNormalization, with the unused flat-term assumptions retained. Likewise expand NatTrans.IsMonoidal.unit and cancel the derived strong unit and target localization unit. Expand the canonical cochain unit mapCochainComplex_η as the single-complex comparison followed by the ordinary inverse unit. The resulting isomorphism is exactly unitComparison. Neither cancellation uses a nonzero ring or nonempty scheme.
